verdict.rationale: The Create Event API tracks an activity against a specific profile and can create or update that profile, with no rigid schema, so custom events are easy to send. Docs also say merchants can set up flows based on Klaviyo events. A community user describes tagging site events and acting on them with automated emails. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a custom metric can be a flow trigger scoped to the event's profile, detail on flow trigger configuration and latency, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-fired events triggering flows.
